posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked: I was wondering about that too, especially because they didn’t pack those foam fillers, so my unsleeved cards flop over and rattle around. I cut up the bubble wrap the box shipped in just to stuff in the empty space…

posts.name: FrivYeti
posts.cooked: I’ve got the heroes along one end, with filler to keep them from falling over, and the villains and environments along the second, with the same. It’s going to be great once an expansion comes out and I can put it all in the same box, but for now the answer is “do some filling of your own” unfortunately.

posts.name: XtremeGuardian
posts.cooked: Can anyone confirm if the box holds sleeved cards? I went in and got the GTG sleeves because Christopher said the box was designed to fit everything sleeved, but I am hearing stories that sleeved cards do not fit in the box unless the token box is removed entirely. Anybody have insight as my copy still has yet to ship.

I put the heroes along one side and the villains and environments along the other and filled in the empty space with token bags. Then I put the villain character cards and spinners in the box and layed out the hero character cards next to it.
